products.name: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance — Commercial
products.short_description: Implement Communication Compliance — policies across Teams/Exchange/channels, classifiers/conditions, reviewer + remediation workflows, and privacy/role-separation guardrails — so violations surface and are handled responsibly. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Detect policy-violating communications — responsibly and at scale

Regulated and sensitive workplaces must monitor communications for harassment, regulatory breaches, and data leaks — without turning into surveillance. This solution implements Communication Compliance in Purview: policies across Teams, Exchange, and connected channels, classifiers and conditions, reviewer workflows and remediation, and the privacy/role-separation guardrails — configured with HR/legal so violations are surfaced and handled responsibly.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — Communication Compliance policies, classifiers/conditions, the reviewer/remediation workflow, scope, and the privacy + role-separation model.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (E5/E5 Compliance, the Communication Compliance roles + separation, HR/legal stakeholders, channels).
  • Implementation Guide — configure privacy + roles, build policies with classifiers/conditions in a pilot scope, set the reviewer workflow + remediation, tune, and expand — pilot-first; outcomes deferred to HR/legal.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (policies detecting, reviewers actioning, privacy controls on) plus Best Practices for responsible, tuned monitoring.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Communication risk surfaced responsibly — policies tuned to real violations, reviewers actioning, privacy and role separation enforced — oversight without surveillance, HR/legal in control.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • PURVCC-Configuration.ps1 — policy + classifier/condition config helper for a PILOT Communication Compliance policy (-WhatIf by default)
    • PURVCC-Discovery.ps1 — read-only Communication Compliance readiness, ROLE-SEPARATION, and privacy/scope assessment
    • PURVCC-Report.ps1 — read-only alert/review ROLLUP report: policy/rule inventory, reviewer assignments, role membership, and CC activity
    • PURVCC-ReviewerWorkflow.ps1 — reviewer-workflow / remediation setup helper: set policy reviewers and enforce role separation (-WhatIf by default)
    • PURVCC-Set-Scope.ps1 — scope/config helper to adjust a Communication Compliance policy's supervised users, reviewers, and conditions (-WhatIf by default)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
